notes.title: Riding Out Version "Early Beta 1.4" is here!
notes.notes:
Today we present you this little update with all the needed functions, before we can add the next big update.

[h1]Release notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved KI.
[*]More setting options (adjustable volume, for music and sounds).
[*]Save game slots (you can have as many game slots as you want).
[*]Bug fix for the horse status.
[*]Walls and foundations can be moved up and down, even after locked in. (it can be set back with „X“).
[*]You can sleep in the beds now. (skip a few ingame hours)
[*]You can save while playing.
[*]You can send us bugs directly while playing by pressing ESC.
[*]You can open the gate at Stefans meadow now. (His horses can’t run away).
[*]Bug fix for the paddock doors.
[*]Bug fix for the seeds.(Was not properly displayed).
[*]Bug fix for the price of the currycomb.
[*]Performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Riding Out Version "Early Beta 1.2" is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Release notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased performance.
[*]Added new Items.
[*]Saddle added.
[*]New Buildparts added.
[*]Plants and stones for the build editor.
[*]Fixed a Bug where horses or items get missed.
[*]Fixed the build material mix problem.
[*]New day and night system.
[*]Added rainy weather.
[*]Fog weather added.
[*]Clouds added.
[*]Added different wind strenght.
[*]New sun and moon.
[*]Fixed some various bugs.
[*]Chests added.
[*]New quests added.
[*]New horses added.
[*]New places added.
[*]Ingame map added (Press M).
[/list]
There is a new save game system. All old save games will be converted to the new. If you want to delete your save game, you have to continue the game first and than go back and delete it.

notes.title: Riding Out Version "Early Beta 1.1" is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Release notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some changes to the camera perpective.
[*]Added Wood to sell and harvest.
[*]New Trade system (You can choose your goods in the shelves).
[*]Sidequests available
[*]Added Sidequests.
[*]New places in the world added.
[*]New horse added.
[*]Horses need food from now on.
[*]You need to care for the horses from now on.
[*]Added affection to the horses (all horses from old save games will have 0 affection, you need to feed them a little bit or brush them with the currycomb, otherwise you cant ride it).
[*]New tools.
[*]New food for the horses.
[*]Horse gender is now show up in the name window.
[*]Performance improvements.
[*]Day-/Night speed improved.
[*]Fixed known bugs (Gameplay and Buildmode).
[*]Horse status overlay added.
[*]Questjournal added, where you can switch between active quests with the key J.
[*]Some Item prices are changed now.
[*]Added collectibles.
[*]New items added.
[*]Added new Characters to the world.
[/list]

To start the new sidequests, you need to take a look around in the town and other places for people or other things who will start the quest.

We recommend to start a new save game to prevent errors from a older state of the game.

With the next update we will add more quests and the horse equipment.
